title: The Voice of Equity: A Systematic Evaluation of Bias Mitigation Techniques for Speech-Based Cognitive Impairment Detection Across Architectures and Demographics
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking algorithmic fairness and distributive justice (equity) across demographic and linguistic subgroups (age, gender, education, language) using technical metrics like Equality of Opportunity. It does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or the models' capacity for moral or ethical reasoning.
